thread:
Ben: Hey team — kicking off the cloud listing sandbox for AWS/Azure/GCP. Need sandbox console access for partner QA and a legal triage on marketplace wording. Who can pick up IAM + SKU mapping?
Sophia: I can own SKU mapping. Can someone drop the current packaging manifest? :eyes:
Ben: here’s the most recent manifest: https://internal.redwood/packaging/cloud-listing/2026-03-manifest.yaml
Jamie: Security: we need a least-privilege IAM example and a list of endpoints we’ll expose in the listing. Rafa/Amy — legal + privacy checks?
Rafa: Please attach the data flow doc. I need to confirm telemetry + telemetry opt-out language for marketplace contracts. EU data residency is a hard constraint for a partner.
Amy: I’ll triage legal. Do we already have the exact copy for the marketplace listing (support level, liability limits, data handling)? If not, I’ll draft.
Ben: EU-only residency is required for one partner. Also need a billing test plan: sandbox SKUs for hosted, dedicated, private; test hooks for meter callbacks.
Sophia: Draft SKU names: redwood.inference.hosted, redwood.inference.dedicated, redwood.inference.private. I’ll create the SKU ids in the billing manifest and share sample JSON.
OnboardBot: [ticket created] TICKET-4531: Marketplace sandbox access request by Ben — assignee: infra-onboarding
Jamie: For IAM, example role snippet to share with vendors:
````
Role: MarketplaceSandboxRole
Permissions:
  - sts:AssumeRole
  - s3:GetObject
  - kms:Decrypt
Resource: arn:aws:s3:::redwood-marketplace-sandbox/*
```
Rafa: Legal needs the customer-facing EULA snippet + explicit support model (SLA vs marketplace support). I’ll attach the previous vendor clause to speed review.
Amy: Key legal bits I need: exact billing language, telemetry retention period, KMS usage (customer-managed or Redwood-managed), and whether we surface audit logs to customers.
Ben: I’ll update the manifest with EU residency flags, add a checkbox for KMS choices, and draft a short test plan. Target: EOD tomorrow for initial sandbox invites.
Sophia: I’ll prepare billing manifest with SKU ids and example pricing tiers. Can someone outline the metered vs committed usage flows we want to test?
Jamie: Metered callbacks: provide endpoint + sample payload. Also request staging parity: us-west-2 and eu-west-1 for latency tests. Need test accounts for benchmarking.
Rafa: Note: Azure Marketplace needs an additional legal attestation form and a publisher verification step — add 2 business days for that.
Ben: Good catch. I’ll add that to the checklist. Also planning to run a short acceptance test with partner QA: installation, provisioning, first inference, billing event.
OnboardBot: TICKET-4531 updated: assignee changed to Sophia
Sophia: Ack — starting SKU mapping today, will attach a CSV with sku_id, name, tier, price by EOD.
Amy: I’ll have a first-pass legal draft by Wednesday morning. Share the manifest changes as soon as you update.
Jamie: @Rafa can you provision the sandbox S3 bucket and share the ARN? We’ll need it for the IAM policy tests.
Rafa: Provisioning now, will post ARN and KMS key id when ready.
Ben: Once ARN and SKUs are live I’ll send invites to partner QA and schedule a 30-min walkthrough. Thanks all :thumbsup:
